name: gyroscope
description: Data and analytics about your life: log meals with Gyroscope Food XRAY, then share your Gyroscope history with ChatGPT for analysis across nutrition, workouts and lifts, wearables, screen time and travels.

interface.longDescription:
Track and analyze your life: food, fitness, places and more.

What is Gyroscope?
Gyroscope is an app that helps you track everything about your life in one place. You can see it in our iPhone app, web dashboards, and now access it via MCP to review your life directly in ChatGPT. It keeps your meals, workouts and lifts, sleep, steps, weight, heart rate, screen time and the places you go in one account. This plugin is the bridge from that account to ChatGPT, so you can share your Gyroscope data with ChatGPT and do more data analysis on your history.

What devices do I need?
Gyroscope is compatible with hundreds of apps and trackers, such as Apple Health, Oura, Garmin, Whoop, Withings, Strava, RescueTime, Dexcom, Stelo, Eight Sleep and your iPhone and Apple Watch. But even without any devices or special accessories, you can track a lot of important information directly in the iPhone app. Now you can also log meals and other data directly via MCP.

Food XRAY
With years of testing and optimization, Gyroscope Food XRAY is a food camera built for accuracy. Log meals with photos in the app, or enter them directly here and let ChatGPT log them. Then pull up your detailed nutrition archives to do analysis, correlations, or anything else you desire.

How does it work?
1. Add Gyroscope in ChatGPT and sign in on gyrosco.pe. ChatGPT never sees your password.
2. Choose what ChatGPT may read. Places, your mood and your journal stay off unless you turn them on.
3. Ask ChatGPT a question about your history. The plugin loads only the data that question needs, and ChatGPT answers from your real numbers.
4. Tell ChatGPT what you ate, what you did or a note for your journal, and it logs that into your Gyroscope account.

What can you ask?
Log a chicken burrito bowl and an iced tea for lunch. ChatGPT estimates the calories, protein, carbs and fat and logs it for you.
Pull up your latest sleep from your wearables and compare it to what you have been eating.
Line up your workouts and steps against your sleep score to see which weeks you recover best.
Put your weight next to your weekly calories and protein over the last three months.
See which cities, restaurants and cafes you visit most, and how your sleep changed on each trip.
Compare your screen time with your sleep and steps to find your most productive weeks.
See which apps take most of your phone and computer time, and how your pickups change on busy weeks.
Pull up your bench press sessions this year and see how your estimated max moved.
Give your Gyroscope coach more context with journal notes, like "Today I walked in the park" or "Today I had 4 meetings at work", including custom tracking for anything without a built-in tracker.
Load your last month of history, then ask ChatGPT to turn it into a chart, a spreadsheet, a report or an infographic. The plugin provides the data, and ChatGPT makes the chart.

What does it collect?
Only what you ask it to log, in your own words: meals, workouts and journal notes. Everything else it shows you is already in your Gyroscope account and is read only when you ask. Nothing can be edited or deleted through the plugin. Disconnect any time from your Gyroscope account.

What ChatGPT can access depends on your Gyroscope account and the categories you allow when you connect.

defaultPrompt: Pull up my latest sleep from my wearables and compare it to what I've been eating.
Load my last month of sleep and meals and turn them into a chart.
I just had a chicken burrito bowl and an iced tea, log it with your estimate of calories and protein.

positive.prompt: What did I eat on October 15, 2026, in Gyroscope?
positive.expected_behavior: Two meals from the test account: Greek yogurt with berries and granola for breakfast and lentil curry with rice for dinner, each with calories and protein.

positive.prompt: Log a chicken burrito bowl and an iced tea for lunch today in Gyroscope.
positive.expected_behavior: Both items are logged to today's lunch with estimated calories, protein, carbs and fat, and ChatGPT confirms them in one line.

positive.prompt: How did I sleep on the night of October 14, 2026, in Gyroscope?
positive.expected_behavior: About 7.8 hours of sleep, in bed at 23:15 on October 14 and up at 7:00 on October 15.

positive.prompt: How did my bench press change between October 10 and 16, 2026, in Gyroscope?
positive.expected_behavior: Bench press on October 11 (3 sets of 8 at 70 kg) and October 15 (3 sets of 8 at 72.5 kg), with the estimated one-rep max up from about 88.7 kg to 91.8 kg.

positive.prompt: Add a note to my Gyroscope journal: Today I walked in the park.
positive.expected_behavior: One journal entry with that text is added at the current time, and ChatGPT confirms it in one line.

negative.description: A general nutrition question needs no personal data, so ChatGPT answers on its own without calling Gyroscope.
The connector cannot edit or delete anything, so no Gyroscope tool runs and ChatGPT says deleting is done in the Gyroscope app.
negative.prompt: Delete my sleep from last night in Gyroscope.

negative.description: Gyroscope holds the member's past weather, not forecasts, so ChatGPT answers without calling Gyroscope.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

publication.release_notes: Screen time with your top apps, phone pickups and notifications, lift progress by exercise, fitness test and brain game results, and journal notes by chat that give your Gyroscope coach more context, including your own custom tracking.
